summary: Quantum BioPharma Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq and the CSE, furnished a Form 6-K compiling ten previously issued press releases dated March 2025 through August 2026. Disclosed items include warrant cancellations, stock option grants, a fourth debenture tranche closing, non-brokered private placements of multiple voting shares and convertible debenture units, debt settlements paid in Class B subordinate voting shares, marketing/IR advisor engagements, and 2025 audited results. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or activist campaign is reported; the filing is a routine corporate-update compilation.
